value.message: Oakville's Preschool Levels A-E swim lessons: their site says fall registration opened Aug 11 at 7am. YMCA of Oakville (ages 3-5) and Making Waves Little Waves (ages 2-5, $33.13 a lesson, their site says) also run them. I could not get into their pages today, so I'll keep watching and text you what I find.
